subject: Pilot credit sponsorship request — PlantSciences Consortium
messages:
From: Dr. Lina Costa <l.costa@plantsciences.edu>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit sponsorship for PlantSciences Consortium

Hi Monica,

I’m reaching out on behalf of the PlantSciences Consortium (a non-profit research collaboration between five universities). We’re preparing a pilot to use large language models for automated literature synthesis and species taxonomy matching across legacy datasets. The project is grant-funded but the budget doesn’t cover cloud inference fees.

Would Redwood consider a promotional credit package or trial extension to run our pilot (estimated 120k generation tokens + embeddings over 3 months)? We can share a short research proposal and IRB summary — attached is a two-page overview.

Key asks:
- 3 months of credits to cover peak pilot usage (ballpark above)
- Confirmation of data handling: are cached prompts retained beyond the trial?
- Any academic/non-profit discounts or expedited paperwork we should complete

We aim to start the pilot in July and would appreciate a quick turnaround. Happy to set a 30-minute call this week.

Best,
Dr. Lina Costa
Director, PlantSciences Consortium
University of Cascadia

Attachment: pilot-proposal-PLANTSCI-2027.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Lina Costa <l.costa@plantsciences.edu>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credit sponsorship for PlantSciences Consortium

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear overview and the proposal. I’m Monica on the Partnerships team at Redwood.

Quick notes and next steps:
- We can absolutely support academic/non-profit pilots; we typically approve promotional credit packages for consortium projects that demonstrate research impact.
- To size the credit, two quick clarifying Qs: (1) the 120k number — is that total generation tokens or does it include embeddings/ingest? and (2) expected concurrency / request pattern (many short prompts vs. long syntheses)?

If the numbers line up, I can request a promo grant (credit code + 3-month expiry) but approvals run through our Grants & Partnerships desk — I’ve looped in Vivek (cc) to expedite. Could you also fill the short eligibility form here: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/PLANTSCI-pilot-proposal ? That will speed sign-off.

We can do a 30-min sync on Wed or Thu — does 10am PT Wed work?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

Hi Monica — thanks for the quick reply, and hi Lina — this is Emily (program lead at GreenLabs, coordinating the technical team). We completed the eligibility form and attached a sample of the sanitized dataset (data-schema-sample.csv). A few clarifications for the approval process: 

- The 120k estimate is: 80k generation tokens (literature syntheses) + 40k embedding units for indexing and similarity search.
- Concurrency: mostly batch jobs during off-hours (10–50 reqs/min peak) but individual synthesis runs can be long (~1.5k tokens).
- Data handling: we are planning to remove all PII before upload; we need confirmation that Redwood will not persist full prompt bodies beyond caching for inference (we can accept short-term KV caching if needed for performance).

Happy to accept a conditional promo code while we work through compliance paperwork. The team can join a Wed 10am PT call — attached is a short usage sheet.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Program Lead, GreenLabs Collective
Attachment: data-schema-sample.csv (text/csv)

Monica / Vivek — reviewed the proposal and the usage breakdown Emily sent. Approving a promotional credit package with the following conditions:

- Promo: 150,000 token-equivalent credits (covers 80k generation + 40k embeddings + buffer)
- Validity: 3 months from activation
- Notes: require signed MSA addendum for academic pilot (standard low-risk wording) and a short Data Use Addendum (no PII to be retained; KV cache allowed for up to 72 hours; logs retained per our retention policy).

Monica — can you please create the promo code (code: PLANTSCI-2027-PILO) and send the MSA addendum link to Lina/Emily? Also flag for Finance if we need a one-off ledger entry (HS-12345). I’ll authorize the credits once the form is submitted and legal confirms the addendum.

Thanks — great pipeline partner.

Marissa Cole
Head of Grants & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
